text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 白色褶皱一字肩短泡袖露腰上衣，白色宽腰胯拼接及踝长裙，白色细横带露趾凉鞋。仅服装与鞋袜；无可拆卸配饰。
original_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one standalone wardrobe catalogue asset from the attached reference: the white off-shoulder gathered short puff-sleeve crop top, long white skirt with smooth fitted wide hip yoke and softly gathered ankle-length flowing hem, and pair of white open-toe slim strap sandals. Pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio light, realistic cloth and construction, portrait 2:3. Show the outfit in a coherent front-facing invisible-mannequin arrangement, hollow open neckline and sleeves, with shoes below. Absolutely no person, skin, body parts, face, hair, mannequin, hanger, stand or background scene. No jewelry or separate accessories. Preserve visible garment details and white color faithfully; conservatively complete occluded seams. Entire garments and shoes uncropped. No text, labels, watermark or added items.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
